subject_name: On-The-Job Training_Đào tạo trong môi trường thực tế
syllabus_name: Đào tạo trong môi trường thực tế
prerequisite: Complete 90% of total credits from semester 1 to semester 5 (excluding National Defense and Physical Education Subject)

general_information.Syllabus Name: Đào tạo trong môi trường thực tế
general_information.Pre-Requisite: Complete 90% of total credits from semester 1 to semester 5 (excluding National Defense and Physical Education Subject)
general_information.Description: Students are sent to enterprises in fields related to their specialty, experiencing a real work process under a plan previously agreed by FPT University and the enterprise, students will have the opportunity to apply the knowledge and skills that they have gained, capture more learnings, set goals and make the choice of their academic concentration at the end of the internship.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Join the internship with a serious spirit. - Perform assigned tasks from enterprises, organizations and internship units. - Participate in internship-related activities. - Completing the evaluation and reporting work during the internship.

description: Students are sent to enterprises in fields related to their specialty, experiencing a real work process under a plan previously agreed by FPT University and the enterprise, students will have the opportunity to apply the knowledge and skills that they have gained, capture more learnings, set goals and make the choice of their academic concentration at the end of the internship.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Knowledge and specialized skills: Apply knowledge and skills learned to successfully complete assigned tasks.
Soft skills: Ability to grasp and handle situations at work, understand and integrate with the culture of the receiving enterprise.
Attitude to work: Comply with discipline, work in a serious and strict manner, have a spirit of teamwork…

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: - Based on the confirmation of the direct manager and according to the working style and regulations of the receiving company.
assessments.Grading Guide: - The enterprise evaluates students' Attitudes based on the form of FPT University.

assessments.Question Type: - Specific tasks are assigned to students based on their knowledge and skills acquired.
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: - Practical knowledge of languages and specialized skills (culture, language...) are trained from semester 1 to semester 5 in the content of the curriculum.
assessments.Grading Guide: - The enterprise evaluates students' Attitudes based on the form of FPT University.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: - The soft skills and knowledge have learned in the university environment and the adaptability of each student.
